notice: 4 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, recaptured from game source 2b1a251 after fidelity pass round 3. Open any picture at its original size.
setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.
Viewpoint ids, positions, look and field of view are those of the 9824fd5 gallery.
Night conditions are taken after the scene's night-light fade completed (recorded nightK = 1 for every night picture).
The captured High-quality frames reach 1,374,415 triangles / 185 draw calls, within the 1.5 M triangle / 400 draw-call frame budget in these frames.
Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted).
